sentence: Was sind deine Pläne für die Zukunft?
translation_en: What are your plans for the future?
What do you want to do later?
I want to do an apprenticeship.

sentence: Ich mache eine Ausbildung zum Mechaniker.
translation_en: I am doing an apprenticeship as a mechanic.

sentence: Sie macht eine Ausbildung zur Friseurin.
translation_en: She is doing an apprenticeship as a hairdresser.
Next year I am doing my Abitur (high school diploma).

sentence: Nach der Schule will ich studieren.
translation_en: After school I want to study.

tip: Stating a specific field of study.
translation_en: I want to study medicine.

sentence: Ich mache ein Praktikum im Krankenhaus.
translation_en: I am doing an internship at the hospital.

sentence: Zuerst will ich den Führerschein machen.
translation_en: First I want to get my driver's license.

tip: Expressing a strong need to pass.
translation_en: I have to pass the driving test!

sentence: Was willst du von Beruf werden?
translation_en: What do you want to become by profession?
I want to become an actor.
She wants to become a singer.
He is becoming a politician.

sentence: Ich will mein eigener Chef sein.
translation_en: I want to be my own boss.

sentence: Ich will unbedingt reich und berühmt werden.
translation_en: I absolutely want to become rich and famous.

tip: Expressing a polite wish about money.
translation_en: I would like to earn a lot of money.

sentence: Geld ist mir nicht so wichtig.
translation_en: Money is not so important to me.

sentence: Wichtig ist, dass ich glücklich bin.
translation_en: The important thing is that I am happy.
I want to go abroad.
We want to travel through Europe.
I dream of a trip around the world.

sentence: Ich will auf keinen Fall heiraten.
tip: Expressing strong rejection of a plan.
translation_en: I definitely do not want to get married.
We want to get married next year.

sentence: Dann wollen wir eine Familie gründen.
translation_en: Then we want to start a family.

sentence: Ich will mindestens drei Kinder haben.
translation_en: I want to have at least three children.

sentence: Er spielt Gitarre in einer Band.
translation_en: He plays guitar in a band.

sentence: Wir haben ein neues Lied geschrieben.
translation_en: We wrote a new song.

sentence: Wir wollen bald ein Konzert geben.
translation_en: We want to give a concert soon.
I have a big wish.
I find that great!
I find that very interesting.

sentence: Ich weiß es noch nicht genau.
translation_en: I don't know exactly yet.
Maybe I will become a teacher.

sentence: Ich schließe bald mein Studium ab.
translation_en: I am completing my studies soon.
How is your internship going?
It is going super!
The job is very exhausting.
I have many customers.
She works as an executive secretary.

sentence: Mein Freund hat die Prüfung bestanden!
translation_en: My boyfriend passed the exam!
The car drives very fast.

sentence: Ich will unbedingt ein Motorrad kaufen.
tip: Expressing a strong intention to buy.
translation_en: I absolutely want to buy a motorcycle.

sentence: Ohne Musik ist das Leben langweilig.
translation_en: Without music life is boring.

sentence: Was ist dein Ziel im Leben?
translation_en: What is your goal in life?

sentence: Ich wünsche dir viel Glück für die Prüfung!
translation_en: I wish you much luck for the exam!

sentence: Er verdient jetzt sein eigenes Geld.
translation_en: He earns his own money now.
We live abroad now.
She is a real star!
Do we want to study together?
I can absolutely recommend that!
